correctness.rationale: Exhaustive enumeration of all C(8,4)=70 balanced words with ballot test yields 14, then Walsh columns χ_S for |S|≤2 (37 columns) or ≤3 (93 columns). Direct symbolic Gram determinant computation independently rebuilt from definitions gives for G2 exactly z(z−12)^3(z−32)^3(z−52)(z−64)^3(z³−142z²+5576z−58112) and for G3 exactly (z−64)(z−96)^3(z−104)(z²−184z+8192)^3(z³−294z²+28528z−912896). These give rank 13 and 14. Eight words formed by 3 variable UD/DU blocks between fixed U,D have alternating cube signs, and every degree≤2 character misses some block, so they span the one-dimensional quadratic nullspace. Krawtchouk distance identity independently explains all Gram entries, and root localization identifies exact min/max eigenvalues 12/α and 64/β. Independent SymPy exact integer charpoly/rank reproduced both polynomials, not just claimed logs.
